offerings.name: Search (flash / fast / standard)
offerings.price_basis: PAYG prepaid credit, flash/fast/standard depth, searchResults outputType
offerings.free_quota: Run 4,000 queries for free. When you first sign up with a professional email address, your account is automatically credited with $20. We will top up eligible accounts back to $20 each month.
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果 (searchResults: array of {name, url, content}) / 带引用答案 (sourcedAnswer) / 结构化 JSON (structured)
offerings.note: flash <200ms, fast ~1s, standard 1-3s; standard 可解释查询、并行子搜索、抓取一个 URL; flash/fast 不调用 LLM。可用域名/日期过滤，maxResults 上限。

offerings.name: Search (deep)
offerings.free_quota: Run 4,000 queries for free. 账户自动获赠 $20，每月补足至 $20。
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果 / 带引用答案 / 结构化 JSON
offerings.note: Multi-iteration agentic search-and-scrape chaining with evaluation, 5-30s。

offerings.name: Research
offerings.pricing: Cost depends on reasoningDepth: "S" $0.25, "M" $0.50, "L" $1.50, "XL" $2.50 per call
offerings.note: Latency 1-10min / asynchronous, best for asynchronous deep research。Tasks endpoint 按对应直接调用同价计费。x402 (USDC on Base) 按相同单次价付费，每请求最低收费 $0.01。错误请求不扣费。
